lines.speaker: sparrow_pilot
lines.text: There's a big shiny web in here. It keeps knitting itself back together every time I cut it.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Teo, don't cut it! That's a shield. A shield that repairs itself.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Do you know what I'd give for a shield that repairs itself? I'd stop sleeping. Again.

lines.speaker: sparrow_pilot
lines.text: It's growing toward the airlock. Slowly. Like a plant toward light.

lines.speaker: captain
lines.text: Pack it in a cold box. We'll fit it properly at Meridian.

lines.speaker: li
lines.text: Vey, a quick one. The relay's patchy out here. Meridian's very quiet tonight. Bring me a story.

lines.speaker: captain
lines.text: I've got a few. Not all of them are good.
